category: embedding and rerank API, monthly free token and request allowance on the Starter plan

free_tier.stated: Starter plan, labelled Free: 5,000,000 embedding tokens a month per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large, pinecone-sparse-english-v0, text-embedding-3-small and -large) and 500 rerank requests a month (bge-reranker-v2-m3, pinecone-rerank-v0)
free_tier.notes: the pricing page lists the three Pinecone-hosted embedding models and bge-reranker-v2-m3 only; the limits page also lists text-embedding-3 models and pinecone-rerank-v0 for Starter; gemini-embedding-2 and cohere-rerank-4-fast are not available on Starter

tooling: Pinecone SDKs and the REST inference endpoints embed and rerank; embeddings can be called without creating an index
chaining: the Starter plan's index allowance (5 indexes, 2 GB) is the same account's vector store, so embed, store and rerank stay under one key

limits.value: Starter: 5,000,000 embedding tokens per month per model and 500 rerank requests per month per rerank model; reaching either returns HTTP 429

Starter embedding throughput 250,000 passage tokens and 50,000 query tokens per minute per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large); bge-reranker-v2-m3 and pinecone-rerank-v0 60 requests per minute; inference requests 100 per second and 2,000 per minute per project

identity_cost.detail: a Pinecone account; the pricing page labels Starter 'Free' and its start link goes to the billing settings of the console; unverified: the sign-up form fields and whether a card is asked, because the console page returned no content to the page reader

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; the Starter allowance is per month and resets
confidence_note: the monthly token and request allowances and the per-minute limits are quoted from the vendor's limits page and pricing page; the sign-up form fields are unverified. The two pages disagree on pinecone-rerank-v0 for Starter.

evidence.quote: | Embedding tokens per month per model | 5,000,000 | 10,000,000 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
evidence.proved: Starter allows 5,000,000 embedding tokens a month per model
Starter allows 500 rerank requests a month on bge-reranker-v2-m3
Starter allows 500 rerank requests a month on pinecone-rerank-v0, which the pricing page does not list for Starter
Starter passage embedding throughput on llama-text-embed-v2 is 250,000 tokens per minute
bge-reranker-v2-m3 is limited to 60 requests per minute on Starter

evidence.quote: | Inference requests per minute per project | 2,000 | 2,000 | 2,000 | 2,000 |
evidence.proved: inference requests are limited to 2,000 per minute per project on every plan

evidence.proved: the pricing page states 5M tokens a month included on Starter for llama-text-embed-v2

evidence.quote: | bge-reranker-v2-m3   | 500 requests/mo incl.         | 1,000 requests/mo incl.         | $2/1k requests     | $2/1k requests     |
evidence.proved: the pricing page states 500 rerank requests a month included on Starter
Pinecone Inference is part of the Starter plan, which the page labels Free

binding_note: 500 rerank requests a month binds first on the rerank side; 5M tokens a month per model on the embedding side
notes: derived for scale: 500 rerank requests a month is about 16 a day, so rerank here suits a prototype or a nightly batch
